comparator.name: Brain Science
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh English/Dutch curriculum pages identify 2026–2027 but link to a repository response containing only the public application shell. The complete public catalogue is explicitly archived as 2025–2026. The unchanged EER Article 8.5 limits its effective year to 2025–2026; Articles 3.6 and 4.2 therefore remain historical credit/progression research, not verified September 2026 rules. The faculty regulations link redirects to institutional sign-in. The current minor menu specifies a 2027–2028 application cycle and does not certify this entrant cohort’s later minor availability. Programme identity and qualitative psychology/biology/computation remain supported; no current unit credit allocation is asserted.
